gc_clock_handling: Only disposable database not_before/pin timestamps were advanced. Production 24h grace was not shortened in application code.
limitations: This evidence does not claim proprietary Box UI/backend parity.
Gotenberg, Tika, ClamAV and Office providers were not configured for these two application runs; separate engine evidence covers provider smoke tests.
final_regression_result: Passed both local and actual S3 application runs with final viewer-specific DLP, signed worker grants, physical GC and expired-upload maintenance code.
fixtures: Each run creates and drops a unique PostgreSQL database and private loopback application. S3 tests use unique disposable Object Lock buckets; provider-retained smoke objects remain protected until their configured test retention expires.

maintenance.scope: upload_session rows and their UUID-validated resumable staging files only; completed file rows and immutable originals are excluded
maintenance.system_attribution: audit_log.actor_id is NULL; required history owner reference is accompanied by explicit system.upload_expired action and expired_by=system metadata
